errors.text: The proposed Nb-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target HEBM-plus-SPS processing intervention or its nanocrystalline FCC/BCC mechanism.
The central claim of retaining ductility is not supported by the cited evidence; E3 explicitly reports decreasing plasticity as Nb-driven Laves-phase content increases.
The base HEA composition is unspecified, so the proposed Nb range, phase evolution, and mechanical response are not reproducible or broadly transferable.
The 1-3 wt% Nb boundary and its stated corrosion rationale are not established by the cited evidence; E4 concerns Mo additions rather than Nb.
